plugin.description: Plugin name as declared in plugin.yml

slug.description: Lowercase slug used in tags and file names

version.description: The plugin release that recorded this fixture

minecraft.description: Server version the fixture was recorded on

kind.description: recorded: produced by running the scenario and re-recorded on promotion. real-world: an anonymised capture from a live server, pinned until a newer capture replaces it

scenario.description: Path of the scenario script in this repository — or, for a real-world fixture, of the note describing its provenance and anonymisation

description.description: One line on what the fixture is, for people

paths.description: Paths inside the server directory that the archive contains (data folder, database files)

expected.description: Count per persisted entity type that a reload must find
